"ELIO" is a DIY bluetooth controller & smartphone application that enhances your creativity and your creative life.

You don't have to worry about even you don't have a knowledge about electronics , program coding , motor/LED.

1) Just connect motor/LED to "ELIO"
2) Create your own controller with model editor
3) Enjoy

You can see various complete toys like airplanes / ships / cars on the market. 
Although these products are diverse, you easily loose interest because simple control and easy assembly. So these toys become a poor toy which was appeared on "Toy story" - Disney animation .

"ELIO" as a DIY bluetooth service platform
1) You as a maker can easily create / realize your creative ideas.
2) You can easily recycle these abandoned toys.

***  Hardware functions ***
1. Supports 2 DC-motors  for speed control
2. Supports 2 SERVO-motors for direction control
3. Supports 4 I/O-ports for LEDs
4. Dedicated 3V / 5V output
All above functions are controlled by PWM(Pulse Width Modulation), so fine speed / direction / brightness control is possible.

***  APP functions ***
1. Model editor
    Model editing feature is a key function, that enables you create your own motion controller. 
    1) Just drag & drop controller that interacts with your finger
    2) Place Motor / LED  in your controller
    3) Adjust detail settings like power range, default value and calibration value for your preferences.

2. Provide default models
    Pre-installed models on the market
    * Demo model, car (SERVO direction / DC direction), Tank, Spider

3. Fixed model
    Also support model which don't need to be controlled like doll's house.

4. Firmware update
    This feature enables ELIO up to date.
